WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trade_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
)
SELECT tradekind,
       trade_count,
       trade_count::numeric / SUM(trade_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM type_counts;
